gloss: slowly and carefully, thoroughly, taking one's time

definitions.explanation: Taking sufficient time to do something carefully and thoroughly without rushing.

examples.japanese: じっくり{考|かんが}えてから{返事|へんじ}をする。
examples.english: I'll think it over carefully before replying.

examples.japanese: {肉|にく}をじっくり{煮込|にこ}む。
じっくり{話|はな}し{合|あ}う{時間|じかん}が{欲|ほ}しい。
examples.english: I want time to have a thorough discussion.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
・じっくり{考|かんが}える (to think carefully)
・じっくり{話|はな}し{合|あ}う (to have a thorough discussion)
・じっくり{煮込|にこ}む (to simmer slowly)
・じっくり{読|よ}む (to read carefully)
・じっくり{取|と}り{組|く}む (to work on something thoroughly)

NUANCE:
Emphasizes taking adequate time without rushing. Often implies a positive approach that leads to better results through patience and care.

CONTRAST:
・じっくり emphasizes taking time carefully
・ゆっくり emphasizes slow speed or relaxation
・{念入|ねんい}りに emphasizes meticulousness

COOKING USAGE:
Very common in cooking contexts for slow-cooking methods that develop flavor.
